assertions.name: gate0_colour_insertion_reduces_to_bare_tau_and_theorem10_holds
assertions.source: GATE 0: the colour-alpha insertion on the order-5 fibre at alpha=1 reproduces the bare tau_N(Sigma(2,3,5)) to ~1e-30 (independent code path), and the bare Theorem-10 exact identity (Hikami eq 5.5) holds to ~1e-28 at N=3,5,7 -- jointly re-validating the transcription chain before any modulus conclusion.

assertions.name: colored_vacuum_row_has_two_independent_moduli_D2_collapse
assertions.source: The genuine Sigma(2,3,5) colored vacuum-row modulus |S_{0,alpha}| over the order-5 SU(2) colour alpha=1..4 takes exactly 2 distinct values (machine-zero to 40 dps): the fibre Weyl reflection alpha<->5-alpha folds alpha=4->1, alpha=3->2, leaving the golden-ratio icosahedral pair. D(2,3,5)=(1)(2)(4)/4=2. The McKay-labelled coloring does NOT escape the D=2 collapse.

assertions.name: modulus_identification_refuted_scope_a
assertions.source: scope-(a) negative: 2 independent geometric moduli cannot carry the 4-class McKay-marked target d_zeta/D (marks {1,4,5,6}); ratio-vector mismatch at every N (golden phi not in the target self-ratios). Conjugation-modulus RESPECTED (not violated); the split electron block correctly uses [5]_zeta+1 not [6]_zeta. Re-derives the s013 refutation explicitly at the McKay-colored level. Evidence not proof; Lean loc_matches gate open; nothing wired to production.

description: Front 2 of 2026-07-17-three-front-attack-specs.md: the Lawrence-Rozansky colored-modulus identification |S_{0lambda}^{Sigma(2,3,5)}(zeta)| =?= d_zeta(lambda)/D(zeta) at fibre roots of unity, colours mapped by McKay(2I<->E8-hat) o (A5 subset S5) with VALUES on the E8 marks {1,4,5,6} (values [1],[4],[5],[5]+1; split electron block (3,1,1)=[5]+1 not [6]). Reuses the machine-validated Hikami machinery (tau_N Gauss sum eq 2.11, phi=181/30, Theorem-10 exact anchor eq 5.5, genuine S-matrix eq 3.8) and adds the colour-alpha insertion on the order-5 icosahedral fibre in the p3=5 numerator. GATE 0 PASSES: alpha=1 reproduces bare tau_N to ~1e-30 and the Theorem-10 identity holds. RESULT: the colored vacuum-row has exactly 2 INDEPENDENT moduli (D=2 collapse) -- the fibre Weyl fold alpha<->5-alpha gives |S_{0,4}|=|S_{0,1}|, |S_{0,3}|=|S_{0,2}|, ratio = golden phi (icosahedral pair); the McKay-labelled coloring does NOT escape the trap. Conjugation-modulus is RESPECTED (not violated); the split node correctly uses [5]_zeta+1 not [6]_zeta at every N. The modulus identification against the 4-class marked target is therefore VACUOUS (2 components cannot carry 4 classes) -- ratio-vector mismatch at every N. VERDICT scope-(a) negative: re-derives the s013 refutation explicitly at the McKay-colored level. Evidence not proof; Lean loc_matches gate open; nothing wired.
